title: Aa Jaie Baba
body:
Aa Jaaiye Baba
Khaimo Me Lagi Aag Kahan Jaaye Sakina
Aa Jaie Baba
Taa Hadd Nazar Sirf Andhera Hi Andhera 2
Aise Me Kaha Jaaon Nazar Kuch Nahi Aata
2.durrane Chale Aaye Hai Khaime Me Sitamgar
Aur Is Tarha Loota Ke Na Sar Par Rahi Chadar 2
Bacchon Ko Bhi Be Reham Lagate Hain Tamacha
Darya Se To Abbas Chacha Bhi Nahi Aaye 2
Kya Sakht Musibat Ki Ghadi Aayi Hai Baba
Har Simt Sitamgar Hai Har Ek Simt Jafa Jai 2
Paauon Me Sukoon Kis Tarha Bin Aap Ke Baba
Dur Chini Laeeno Ne Hai Khoon Kaano Se Jaari 2
Rone Pe Bhi Paabandi Hai Haye Haye Mere Baba
Be Jurm O khata Baba Bohat Zulm Sahe Hai 2
Mar Jaaungi Bin Aap Ke Aa Jaiye Baba
Lillah Kare In Pe Bhi Ab Chashme Inayat 2
Roze Pe Sakeena Ke Padhe Jaa Ke Ye Nauha
Aa Jaaiye Baba
